source_note: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别
english_source_note: Riemann Integral and Criteria for Integrability
callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#8
statement_en: A bounded function $f$ is Riemann integrable on the closed interval $[a,b]$ if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$ such that for every partition with $\lambda(P)<\delta_{\varepsilon}$, one has $$\sum_{i=1}^n \omega_f([x_{i-1},x_i])(x_i-x_{i-1})<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: 一个有界函数$f$在闭区间$[a,b]$上黎曼可积，当且仅当对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$使得对任意的满足$\lambda(P)<\delta_{\varepsilon}$都有$$\sum_{i=1}^n \omega_f([x_{i-1},x_i])(x_i-x_{i-1})<\varepsilon$$
